members.name: Name

members.name: Rename
members.signature: Public Sub Rename(ByVal newName As String)
members.description: Renames the file. The new name must be a bare name, or a path that resolves to the same folder as the source — it cannot move the item to a different folder. Wildcards are not permitted, and the destination must not already exist.

members.name: SetAttribute
members.signature: Public Sub SetAttribute(ByVal attr As FileAttribute, ByVal state As Boolean)

members.name: ShortName

members.description: Returns the file's 8.3 short name, or the normal file name unchanged when no short name is available - which includes volumes with 8.3 name generation disabled and paths longer than 260 characters. Compare the result with Name to tell whether shortening actually occurred.

members.name: ShortPath
members.signature: Public Property Get ShortPath() As String
members.description: Returns the file's 8.3 short path, or the full path unchanged when no short name is available - which includes volumes with 8.3 name generation disabled and paths longer than 260 characters. Compare the result with the full path to tell whether shortening actually occurred.

members.name: Size
members.signature: Public Property Get Size() As LongLong
members.description: Returns the size, in bytes, of a specified file.

members.name: ToStream
members.signature: Public Function ToStream(Optional ByVal maxBytesToRead As Long = -1) As Byte()
members.description: Reads the file specified into a byte array.

members.name: ToString
members.signature: Public Function ToString(Optional ByVal encoding As TextEncoding = encAutoDetect, Optional ByVal lineEnding As NewlineType = nlNoChange) As String
members.description: Reads the entire text file to a string. With encAutoDetect (default) the encoding is detected; otherwise the given encoding is used (a byte-order mark still overrides it). A leading BOM is stripped either way.

members.name: Type
members.signature: Public Property Get Type() As String
members.description: Returns the shell's type description for a file or folder (e.g. "Text Document", "Application", "File Folder"), the same string Explorer and Scripting.FileSystemObject's File.Type show. Falls back to "<EXT> File" or "File" when the shell is unavailable, and for paths longer than 260 characters, which the shell APIs do not support.

members.name: Version
members.signature: Public Property Get Version(Optional ByVal source As FileVersionSource = fvFixed) As String
members.description: Returns the file's version. By default (fvFixed) returns the binary version as major.minor.build.revision, fvFileString returns the authored StringFileInfo FileVersion string and fvProductString returns the ProductVersion string; both fall back to the fixed version when the file has no string block. Returns an empty string when the file carries no version resource, and also for paths longer than 260 characters, which the version-resource APIs do not support.

types.name: FileSystemObject
types.description: This class replaces or improves on most functionality of the FileSystemObject, adding reading and writing on non-UTF16 encoded files.

members.name: ArrayToTextFile
members.signature: Public Sub ArrayToTextFile(ByRef lines() As String, ByVal filePath As String, Optional ByVal encoding As TextEncoding = encUtf8, Optional ByVal lineEnding As NewlineType = nlWindows)
members.description: Writes an array of lines to a file in the specified encoding (a BOM is emitted only for BOM-bearing members such as encUtf8Bom). Overwrites any existing file.

members.name: BuildPath
members.signature: Public Function BuildPath(ByVal path As String, ByVal name As String) As String
members.description: Combines a folder path and the name of a folder or file and returns the combination with valid path separators.

members.name: CleanFileName
members.signature: Public Function CleanFileName(ByVal fileName As String, Optional ByVal replaceChar As String = "") As String
members.description: Cleans a file name (not a path) of items that are invalid in Windows: the reserved characters \ / : * ? " < > |, control characters, leading/trailing spaces, trailing dots, and reserved device names such as CON, PRN, NUL, COM0-9 and LPT0-9.

members.name: CopyFile
members.signature: Public Sub CopyFile(ByVal source As String, ByVal destination As String, Optional ByVal overwrite As Boolean = True)
members.description: Copies a file to the destination path specified. Wildcards are supported in the last component of source.

members.name: CopyFolder
members.signature: Public Sub CopyFolder(ByVal source As String, ByVal destination As String, Optional ByVal overwrite As Boolean = True)
members.description: Copies a folder to the destination path specified.

members.name: CreateFolder
members.signature: Public Function CreateFolder(ByVal path As String, Optional ByVal createIntermediates As Boolean = False) As Folder
members.description: Creates a folder and returns the new Folder. Errors if it already exists. By default only the leaf is created; pass createIntermediates:=True to also create any missing intermediate folders.

members.name: CreateTextFile
members.signature: Public Function CreateTextFile(ByVal fileName As String, Optional ByVal overwrite As Boolean = True, Optional ByVal encoding As TextEncoding = encUtf8, Optional ByVal lineEnding As NewlineType = nlWindows) As TextStream
members.description: Creates (or overwrites) a text file and returns a TextStream open for writing.

members.name: DeleteFile
members.signature: Public Sub DeleteFile(ByVal fileSpec As String, Optional ByVal force As Boolean = False, Optional ByVal ignoreMissing As Boolean = False)
members.description: Deletes the specified file (wildcards supported). force clears a read-only attribute first. ignoreMissing (default False) suppresses the file-not-found error when the path or wildcard pattern matches nothing; it does not suppress other failures such as the path being a directory or the file being locked.

members.name: DeleteFolder
members.signature: Public Sub DeleteFolder(ByVal folderSpec As String, Optional ByVal force As Boolean = False, Optional ByVal ignoreMissing As Boolean = False)
members.description: Deletes a folder and its contents (wildcards supported). force clears read-only attributes as it goes. ignoreMissing (default False) suppresses the path-not-found error when the folder or wildcard pattern matches nothing; it does not suppress other failures such as the path being a file or the folder being locked or non-empty.

members.name: DriveExists
members.signature: Public Function DriveExists(ByVal driveSpec As String) As Boolean
members.description: Returns True if a specified drive exists; False if it does not.

members.name: Drives
members.signature: Public Function Drives() As Drives
members.description: Returns a Drives collection of all logical drives present on the system.

members.name: FileContainsText
members.signature: Public Function FileContainsText(ByVal filePath As String, ByVal searchText As String, Optional ByVal ignoreCase As Boolean = True) As Boolean
members.description: Returns True if the given text is found in the file's decoded contents. Encoding is auto-detected; returns False for a binary or unknown-encoding file. Raises 5 on an empty search string.

members.name: FileExists
members.signature: Public Function FileExists(ByVal fileSpec As String) As Boolean
members.description: Returns True if a specified file exists; False if it does not.

members.name: FindInTextFiles
members.signature: Public Function FindInTextFiles( ByVal folderPath As String, ByVal searchText As String, Optional ByVal filePattern As String = "*", Optional ByVal recursive As Boolean = False, Optional ByVal ignoreCase As Boolean = True, Optional ByVal fileSizeCapInMb As Long = -1) As Collection
members.description: Returns the paths of text files under a folder whose decoded contents contain the given text. Encoding is auto-detected per file; binary or unknown-encoding files are skipped.

members.name: FolderExists
members.signature: Public Function FolderExists(ByVal folderSpec As String) As Boolean
members.description: Returns True if a specified folder exists; False if it does not.

members.name: GetAbsolutePathName
members.signature: Public Function GetAbsolutePathName(ByVal path As String, Optional ByVal baseDirectory As String = "") As String
members.description: Returns a complete and unambiguous path from a path specification, resolving from the current directory or baseDirectory if supplied. The input path need not exist.

members.name: GetBaseName
members.signature: Public Function GetBaseName(ByVal path As String) As String
members.description: Returns a string containing the base name of the last component, less any file extension, in a path.

members.name: GetCurrentDir
members.signature: Public Function GetCurrentDir() As String
members.description: Returns the current directory.

members.name: GetDrive
members.signature: Public Function GetDrive(ByVal driveSpec As String) As Drive
members.description: Returns a Drive object for a drive spec: "C", "C:", "C:\", a UNC share, or any path on the drive.

members.name: GetDriveName
members.signature: Public Function GetDriveName(ByVal path As String) As String
members.description: Returns a string containing the name of the drive for a specified path.

members.name: GetExtensionName
members.signature: Public Function GetExtensionName(ByVal path As String) As String
members.description: Returns a string containing the extension name for the last component in a path.

members.name: GetFile
members.signature: Public Function GetFile(ByVal filePath As String) As File
members.description: Returns a File object for an existing file.

members.name: GetFileEncoding
members.signature: Public Function GetFileEncoding(ByVal filePath As String) As TextEncoding
members.description: Detects a file's text encoding from a head sample (default 64 KB): BOM sniff first, then UTF-16/32 and UTF-8 heuristics, else system ANSI. Returns a signed TextEncoding (negative = BOM present), or encUnknown if the file is empty or looks binary. Raises if the file cannot be read.

members.name: GetFileLineEnding
members.signature: Public Function GetFileLineEnding(ByVal filePath As String, Optional ByVal encoding As TextEncoding = encAutoDetect) As NewlineType
members.description: Reads a text file and reports its line-ending style: nlWindows / nlUnix / nlMacintosh for a consistent file, nlMixed if it contains more than one, or nlUnknown if it has none. Reads the whole file, so the result (including mixed) is exact.

members.name: GetFileName
members.signature: Public Function GetFileName(ByVal path As String) As String
members.description: Returns the last component of a specified path that is not part of the drive specification.

members.name: GetFilePaths
members.signature: Public Function GetFilePaths(ByVal folderPath As String, Optional ByVal pattern As String = "*", Optional ByVal includeHidden As Boolean = False, Optional ByVal includeSystem As Boolean = False, Optional ByVal recursive As Boolean = False) As Collection
members.description: Returns a Collection of full file paths in the specified folder. Supports a wildcard pattern, optional recursion into subfolders, inclusion of hidden/system files.

members.name: GetFileType
members.signature: Public Function GetFileType(ByVal filePath As String) As String
members.description: Returns the shell's type description for a file or folder (e.g. "Text Document", "Application", "File Folder"), the same string Explorer and Scripting.FileSystemObject's File.Type show. Falls back to "<EXT> File" or "File" when the shell is unavailable, and for paths longer than 260 characters, which the shell APIs do not support.

members.name: GetFileVersion
members.signature: Public Function GetFileVersion(ByVal fileName As String, Optional ByVal source As FileVersionSource = fvFixed) As String
members.description: Returns the file's version. By default (fvFixed) returns the binary version as major.minor.build.revision, fvFileString returns the authored StringFileInfo FileVersion string and fvProductString returns the ProductVersion string; both fall back to the fixed version when the file has no string block. Returns an empty string when the file carries no version resource, and also for paths longer than 260 characters, which the version-resource APIs do not support.

members.name: GetFolder
members.signature: Public Function GetFolder(ByVal folderPath As String) As Folder
members.description: Returns a Folder object for an existing folder.

members.name: GetParentFolderName
members.signature: Public Function GetParentFolderName(ByVal path As String) As String
members.description: Returns a string containing the name of the parent folder of the last component in a specified path.

members.name: GetRelativePath
members.signature: Public Function GetRelativePath(ByVal basePath As String, ByVal targetPath As String, Optional ByVal basePathIsFolder As Boolean = True, Optional ByVal trimLeadingDotSlash As Boolean = True) As String
members.description: Returns a relative path from a base path to a target path. The base path is treated as a folder by default. Relative inputs are resolved against the current directory. Returns the absolute target if no relative path exists (e.g. different drives).

members.name: GetSpecialFolder
members.signature: Public Function GetSpecialFolder(ByVal specialFolder As SpecialFolderConst) As String
members.description: Returns the absolute path to the requested known folder. The returned path does NOT include a trailing backslash.

members.name: GetStandardStream
members.signature: Public Function GetStandardStream(ByVal standardStreamType As StandardStreamTypes, Optional ByVal unicode As Boolean = False) As TextStream
members.description: Returns a TextStream over one of the process's standard streams. unicode:=True gives UTF-16LE (no BOM); default is the system ANSI code page. Raises if no handle is available (e.g. no console).

members.name: GetTempName
members.signature: Public Function GetTempName(Optional ByVal prefix As String, Optional ByVal extension As String = ".tmp", Optional ByVal inFolder As String = "") As String
members.description: Returns a randomly generated temporary file or folder name. If inFolder is supplied, the returned name is one that does not already exist in that folder at the time of the call.

members.name: IsFileLocked
members.signature: Public Function IsFileLocked(ByVal filePath As String) As Boolean
members.description: Returns True if the file is currently locked by another process - that is, if it cannot be opened for exclusive read/write access right now. The answer is only valid for the instant of the call. Raises if the file does not exist.

members.name: MergeTextFiles
members.signature: Public Sub MergeTextFiles(ByVal firstFilePath As String, ByVal secondFilePath As String, Optional ByVal outputFilePath As String, Optional ByVal insertBlankLineBetween As Boolean = False, Optional ByVal firstFileEncoding As TextEncoding = encAutoDetect, Optional ByVal secondFileEncoding As TextEncoding = encAutoDetect)
members.description: Merges two text files in the order specified. If outputFilePath is omitted, the first file is overwritten in place. The second file's line endings are converted to match the first file's. Streams line by line, so file size is not limited.

members.name: MoveFile
members.signature: Public Sub MoveFile(ByVal source As String, ByVal destination As String)
members.description: Moves one or more files from one location to another.

members.name: MoveFolder
members.signature: Public Sub MoveFolder(ByVal source As String, ByVal destination As String)
members.description: Moves a folder from one location to another.

members.name: NormalizeTextFile
members.signature: Public Function NormalizeTextFile(ByVal filePath As String, Optional ByVal toEncoding As TextEncoding = encUtf8, Optional ByVal toNewLine As NewlineType = nlWindows, Optional ByVal fromEncoding As TextEncoding = encAutoDetect, Optional ByVal toAttributes As FileAttribute = faNoChange) As Boolean
members.description: Rewrites a text file in place in the target encoding and newline style (source auto-detected). toAttributes enforces a target attribute set (settable bits only); NoChange (the default) preserves the file's current attributes. Skips the write when content is already in target form. Refuses binary files. Returns True if the file was modified.

members.name: OpenTextFile
members.signature: Public Function OpenTextFile(ByVal fileName As String, Optional ByVal ioMode As IOMode = ForReading, Optional ByVal create As Boolean = False, Optional ByVal encoding As TextEncoding = encAutoDetect, Optional ByVal writeModeLineEnding As NewlineType = nlWindows) As TextStream
members.description: Opens a text file and returns a streaming TextStream. For reading, omit encoding (encAutoDetect) to detect it from a head sample. For writing/appending, encoding selects the output encoding (default UTF-8, no BOM). Encodings whose chunk boundaries cannot be managed (UTF-7, unclassifiable code pages) transparently fall back to a buffered path.
